#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

using i64 = long long;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, m, MOD;
    cin >> n >> m >> MOD;
    
    const int MAX = 507;
    vector<vector<i64>> fac(MAX, vector<i64>(MAX, 1));
    vector<vector<i64>> ifac(MAX, vector<i64>(MAX, 1));
    vector<vector<i64>> f(MAX, vector<i64>(MAX, 0));
    vector<vector<i64>> g(MAX, vector<i64>(MAX, 0));
    vector<vector<i64>> ans(MAX, vector<i64>(MAX, 0));
    vector<vector<i64>> sum(MAX, vector<i64>(MAX, 0));
    
    auto modPow = [&](i64 base, int exp) -> i64 {
        i64 res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    };
    
    auto binom = [&](int a, int b) -> i64 {
        if (a < b || b < 0) return 0;
        return fac[a][a] * ifac[b][b] % MOD * ifac[a - b][a - b] % MOD;
    };
    
    auto tri = [](int x) -> i64 {
        return 1LL * x * (x + 1) / 2;
    };
    
    fac[0][0] = ifac[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 500; ++i) {
        fac[i][i] = fac[i - 1][i - 1] * i % MOD;
        ifac[i][i] = modPow(fac[i][i], MOD - 2);
    }
    
    for (int len = 1; len <= n; ++len) {
        for (int l = 1; l + len - 1 <= n; ++l) {
            int r = l + len - 1;
            if (l == r) {
                f[l][r] = 0;
                g[l][r] = 2;
            } else {
                g[l][r] = 2 * (g[l + 1][r] + g[l][r - 1]) % MOD;
                
                for (int x = l + 1; x <= r; ++x) {
                    f[l][r] = (f[l][r] + f[l + 1][r] + g[l + 1][r] * (x - l)) % MOD;
                    g[l][r] = (g[l][r] + g[l + 1][r]) % MOD;
                }
                
                for (int x = l; x <= r - 1; ++x) {
                    f[l][r] = (f[l][r] + f[l][r - 1] + g[l][r - 1] * (r - x)) % MOD;
                    g[l][r] = (g[l][r] + g[l][r - 1]) % MOD;
                }
                
                f[l][r] = (f[l][r] + 2 * f[l + 1][r] % MOD + 2 * f[l][r - 1]) % MOD;
                
                for (int x = l + 1; x <= r - 1; ++x) {
                    i64 term1 = (f[l][x - 1] * g[x + 1][r] % MOD + f[x + 1][r] * g[l][x - 1]) % MOD;
                    term1 = term1 * (len + 2) % MOD * binom(len - 1, x - l) % MOD;
                    f[l][r] = (f[l][r] + term1) % MOD;
                    
                    i64 term2 = (tri(x - l) + tri(r - x)) % MOD;
                    term2 = term2 * g[x + 1][r] % MOD * g[l][x - 1] % MOD * binom(len - 1, x - l) % MOD;
                    f[l][r] = (f[l][r] + term2) % MOD;
                    
                    i64 term3 = g[x + 1][r] * g[l][x - 1] % MOD * binom(len - 1, x - l) % MOD * (len + 2) % MOD;
                    g[l][r] = (g[l][r] + term3) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    ans[0][0] = 0;
    sum[0][0] = 1;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= m; ++k) {

                sum[j + 1][t] = (sum[j + 1][t] + g[i][j] * sum[i - 1][k] % MOD * comb) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
            ans[i][j] = (ans[i][j] + ans[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            sum[i][j] = (sum[i][j] + sum[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    cout << (ans[n + 1][m] + ans[n][m]) % MOD << '\n';
    return 0;
}
